_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fiber_reinforced#0. An HGO material with <mat_axis> DELETED produces logged data BIT-IDENTICAL to the same material with a = (1,0,0), d = (0,1,0) written out, while a frame aligned with the load gives measurably different stresses. All three runs reach normal termination with exit 0 and no warning, which is why the omission survives a smoke test. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'hgo_mat_axis_default=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
